12pt Herbal Curative.description: Cures 12 tblp per dose, as per a 6pt herbal cure potion.

2pt Locational Salve.description: Rub on a wounded location to heal 2 pts locational (no tblp).

36pt tblp Cure.description: Cures 36 tblp; requires 18 tblp Cure recipe.

Acid.description: Acts as Shatter (t) on small objects; careful application needed; harmful if mishandled; specific effects detailed.

Anger.description: Choice: take periodic tblp or enter 25% rage for 1 hour; post-effects include kick-out and Strength lockout.

Anti-Venom Salve.description: Applied before kick-in, counters one dose of Blade Venom on the blow that caused the wound.

Anti-Venom True.description: Completely negates poison effects; if drunk in advance, negates next three doses within 1 hour.

Blade Blindness.description: Blade venom variant: 30s after entry, target is blind for 5 min; standard immunities/antidotes apply.

Blade Deafness.description: Blade venom variant: 30s after entry, target is deaf for 5 min; standard immunities/antidotes apply.

Blade Dumbness.description: Blade venom variant: 30s after entry, target is struck dumb for 5 min; standard immunities/antidotes apply.

Blade Nerve Venom.description: Blade venom variant: 30s after entry, target suffers -2 DAC permanently until regeneration; no effect on elves/elven-immunity.

Blade Paralysis.description: Blade venom variant: 30s after entry, target is paralysed for 5 min; standard immunities/cures apply.

Blade Sleep.description: Blade venom variant: 30s after entry, target sleeps for 10 min; early waking leaves -2 DAC until proper end.

Blade Venom ‘8’.description: As Blade Venom ‘6’ but inflicts 48 tblp; requires Ingestive Venom ‘8’ recipe.

Blade-True.description: Coat metal object <27 ft³; 30 min indestructible (immune to Shatter/Disintegrate); bladed weapons count +1.

Buckland Hoby’s Essence Binding Powder.description: Complex ritual to solidify an elf’s essence for transport/restoration point; prerequisites and limits apply.

Burn Salve.description: Within 15 min of fire injury, heals 6 tblp and up to 6 pts locational fire damage (spread across locations).

Crystal-Glitter.description: Thrown powder prevents Chameleon/Invisibility etc. for 5 min; removable by brushing for 2 min.

Deadening Elixir.description: 15 min: no touch; -3 DAC (min 0); no Rage; immunity to Pain; 25% off all damage types.

Dragon’s Blood.description: +2 MAC and +1 resist vs magical effects for 15 min; not cumulative; at end take 12/2 physical fire damage.

Embalming Salve.description: Preserves a corpse (within 1 hour); grants benefits of fated hero; application time and details specified.

Endurance.description: Next 18 tblp taken in 5 min is ignored (locational still applies); 12 tblp kick-out at end.

Frog-Leg.description: Jump once within 15 min (twice if recipe known).

Holy/Unholy Water.description: Requires 24h Bless/Curse during manufacture; multiple uses (warding, balm, weapon application). Alignment restrictions apply.
ingredients: Opal Dust or Black Opal Dust

Hyper-Action.description: 1 hour: +4 DAC and Determination-like effects; then 24 tblp kick-out.

Ingested Nerve Venom.description: 30s after drinking: -2 DAC permanently (until Regen or similar); no effect on elves/elven-immunity.

Ingestive Illness.description: As Cause Disease (non-spiritual). With 7th resist ends at 30-min stage; with 9th ends at 10-min stage; nausea after 2 min.

Ingestive Venom ‘8’.description: As Ingestive Venom ‘6’ but inflicts 48 tblp after 30s.

Lembas.description: Only for characters who can racially make Lembas; manufactures that type as normal; can be done in addition to racial Lembas make.

Magical Baffle Salve.description: Scout-only apply to magical object <27 ft³ to hide magic for up to 8 hours or until triggered/used.

Medicated Bandages.description: Prereq: Treated Bandages. If applier knows recipe: 2 loc + tblp, then +2/5min to max 18. Otherwise reduced effect.

Mind Dull.description: 15 min Psionic Retardation (Mind Block as Monk; no neuronics). 6 tblp kick-out (3 to head).

Mystic Honey.description: Requires Purgative. Choose one: cure diseases; restore one level lost to casting; restore any lost grades of strength.

Numbing Elixir.description: Numbs sensations for 15 min: -1 DAC (min 0) but half effect from Pain/pain-based attacks.

Protection from Psionics.description: Full immunity to neuronics for 15 min; then 6 head damage and 12 tblp kick-out; reduced effect if recipe not known.

Purgative.description: 5 minutes of queasiness (-2 DAC, -1 weapon mastery; mins 0). Halts and then negates non-supernatural disease; resets supernatural diseases to zero minutes.

Regenerative Elixir.description: 1 hour: stops bleeding, regenerates regularly; double if resting; then half benefit from other healing for duration+1h.

Rejuvenation.description: Prereq: Resuscitation Balm. If within live-to-minus/survive unconscious, after 30s restores to weak consciousness; wears off after 5 min.

Resuscitation Balm.description: Requires 2pt Locational Salve. Cures 6 tblp and 2 pts locational when applied.

Scent Inhibitor.description: Apply to face; 1 hour immunity to olfactory attacks; prevents use of Sniff/Locational Sniff.

Scent Neutraliser.description: Salve applied to all body; for 1 hour grants neutral smell; immunity to Sniff/Locational Sniff and similar.

Smelling Salts.description: Breaks a stopping effect for 5 min on a helpless/willing target; target then cannot use Strength or Dex AC for 5 min.

Star-Metal.description: +1 cumulative MAC for 5 min; -3 casting levels for magic spells; won’t stack with Plate spells.

Stomach-Lining.description: Immediately 6 tblp (3 abdomen). For 1 hour immune to ingested potions (beneficial or harmful). Lembas halved.

Strength.description: +1 stacking Strength (max +2) for 5 min; Brute intelligence; no casting/neuronics/weapon masteries; 12 tblp kick-out at end.

Strengthening Salve.description: +2 PAC for 15 minutes when rubbed in; coats all humanoid locations; doesn’t stack with Barkskin or racial PAC.

Studied Lembas.description: Make as many of the same Lembas as skill allows; certain races get +1 skill; elves making own type can do it in addition; those making own racial type can reduce cost to 60G/dose.

Super Endurance.description: As Endurance but 36 tblp temp life; at end take 30 tblp; requires Endurance recipe.

Sweet Dreams.description: Requires 30s calm prep; deep sleep (cannot be woken) up to 15 min; if uninterrupted grants 30 min meditation equivalent.

Treated Bandages.description: Applied 30s; heals 4 locational; if applier knows the recipe also heals 4 tblp. Leave in place 5 min.

Venom Concealment.description: 10 ml dose; added to another liquid poison, hides it from discernment for 1 hour (then both become useless).

Venom ‘8’ Antidote.description: Negates 8 grades of poison. If taken in advance, lasts 1 hour and negates first incoming poison up to 8 grades.

Vibrance.description: No immediate effect; 5 min later the drinker is cured 12 tblp.

Vision Salve.description: Apply around eyes; see in supernatural darkness/Mists/blindness; 5 min (30 if user knows recipe).

Wild Frenzy.description: 5 min: 33% berserk rage and attitude; at end 36 tblp and 2 min unavoidable unconsciousness.

Will-Focus.description: For 1 hour, act as +2 resistance levels; each use deals 6 tblp; afterwards -1 resistance for 5 min and 18 tblp kick-out.

Wireweed.description: Mixed into one ingestive healing dose: for up to 5 min makes it a contact paste; after 5 min the dose is ruined.

Wooden Horse.description: Cures 6 tblp immediately; 5 min later inflicts 18 tblp poison; does not discern as poison.

Zombie.description: Applied to temples: immunity to fear/emotion/rage, -1 resistance; lasts 5 min (15 if applier knows the recipe).
